translationRepairs: He went himself to mourn at Prince Wei Shaowang's house.
He went himself to mourn at Prince Wei Shao's house.
Remove redundant wang in "Wei Shaowang"; title is Prince Wei Shao (衛紹王).
On bingwu he granted Hushahu a residence of the foremost stud-prince rank.
On bingwu he granted Hushahu a residence of the foremost imperial son-in-law rank.
駙馬 is imperial son-in-law, not "stud-prince".

On xinhai Marshalate Right Deputy Supervisor Tuhu Gaoqi fought north of the city, lost twice, and came back; then he took soldiers to Hushahu's house, killed him, and brought the head to court to answer for his deed.

Unify 朮虎高琪 romanization to Shuhu Gaoqi (matches s0062).
On guiwei an edict posthumously granted offices to Peiman Fuxing, who had died in service, and to Zhiyang and Shigu Nai.
On guiwei an edict posthumously granted offices to Peiman Fuxing, who had died in service, and to Shanyang and Shigu Nai.
Unify 鄯陽 to Shanyang (matches s0049).
On xinwei Great Yuan forces overran Zhangde prefecture; Acting Prefect Huang Boojiuzhu was killed.
On xinwei Great Yuan forces overran Zhangde prefecture; Acting Prefect Huanggua Jiuzhu was killed.
黃摑九住 is Huanggua Jiuzhu, not Huang Boojiuzhu.
On yiyou the recluse Wang Huang was summoned; he did not come.
On yiyou the recluse Wang Hui was summoned; he did not come.
王澮 is Wang Hui, not Wang Huang.
Right Director Tushan Yi was moved to the left directorship and enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping Commandery.
Right Director Tudan Yi was moved to the left directorship and enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping Commandery.
Unify 徒單鎰 surname romanization to Tudan (matches other Tudan names).

Left Director Tudan Yi received the Dierru hereditary meng'an in Zhongdu Circuit.
Unify 徒單鎰 surname romanization to Tudan.

On gengyin the daughter of Prince Wei Shao was sent in marriage to the Great Yuan Founding Emperor (Genghis Khan); she became princess-empress.
Fix garbled "palace-guard Shaowang princess"; 衛紹王公主 is Prince Wei Shao's daughter.

On gengxu Left Chancellor Tudan Yi, Prince of Guangping Commandery and supervisor of the national history, died.
Normalize title to Prince of Guangping Commandery (廣平郡王; source 郡主 is a corruption of 郡王).

On yimao the Ministry memorialized proposing a tour to Nanjing; the emperor consented.

乙裏只 is the Yuan envoy Yilibozhi, not Jebe.
The emperor consented to the memorial.

An edict appointed the recluse Wang Hui Grand Master of the Palace and right remonstrator and made him staff planner of the Liaodong Pacification Commission.
王澮 is Wang Hui (matches chunk 001 display).
